scope: fixed factorial ablation on previously examined Farm A, exploratory retrospective evaluation, not independent validation
generator_relation: signed generator DE minus NDE temperature (sensor_13_avg-sensor_14_avg), two-sided calibrated deviation from expected normal difference
transformer_relation: maximum minus minimum of all three transformer phase temperatures (sensor_38/39/40_avg), positive deviation from expected normal spread, require all three finite
power30_policy: replace power_29 by power_30 only in current/1h/6h power regime inputs; preserve anonymized raw numerical scale, no division by power and no conversion to kW
relations_only_policy: reuse four frozen original temperature regressors/calibration, fit only two relation regressors with old power29 regime
power30_only_policy: refit original four temperature regressors on identical historical normal roles using power30 regime, no relation targets
combined_policy: reuse four newly fitted power30 regressors, fit two relation regressors using power30 regime
training_and_quality: inherit exact past normal train/calibration masks and hyperparameters; nonfinite -> missing; finite extremes retained; no failure-label-dependent filtering
signed_calibration: past calibration only: median residual and max(q95(abs(residual-median)),1 Celsius); positive-only targets retain baseline q95-median scale
score: maximum nonnegative calibrated residual across targets, absolute residual only for generator difference, causal trailing mean of three hourly available points
threshold_policy: each source and variant independently uses only certified historical normal calibration; same <=2 false episodes/720 normal hours and <=5% warning time; never select thresholds on prediction partition
episode_policy: all 11 inherited canonical events, new below-to-above crossing in [anchor-24h,anchor); retain missing decisions and unknown labels
promotion_gate: more than four detected events, false episode rate <=2/720h, normal warning fraction <=5%, availability at least baseline minus 0.01; exploratory success only nominates shadow candidate, not externally validated model
multiple_comparison_policy: report all three predeclared variants, no post-test feature/threshold tuning or ensemble selection
score_semantics: normal relation/temperature deviation, not calibrated failure probability, RUL, or future sensor trajectory
